text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automatic alert: p99 spike detected on router->lb path (region: ap-southeast-1). p95 jumped from ~180ms to 1.1s, p99 from ~620ms to 4.0s in ~15m. Streaming stalls increasing rapidly. Collecting diagnostics (top keys, route distribution, backend load).

maya (oncall): I'm paged, taking lead. Putting channel into livepager mode. @leo @hana @owen join please.

leo (sre): here. pulling percentile histos and top key list. odd distribution: <0.05% keys are responsible for ~50% of p99 samples. looks concentrated to a handful of nodes in ap1 zone.

hana (router): checking recent routing changes — there was a light rollout of a new zone-affinity policy 12m ago (rollout id: aff-2026-06-01-18). I see a handful of weight entries with explicit 0.0 fallback for nearby zones, which combined with an empty hash_seed on some shards collapses mapping.

owen (runtime): runtime snapshot: 
```
metric router.latency.p99=4005ms
metric streaming.stalls=1047 (+950 in 12m)
hot_backend_top3: ap1a-node-21, ap1a-node-22, ap1a-node-07
cache_eviction_rate=+22x
```

maya (oncall): customer impact? zara?

zara (product): support has 6 flagged tickets for live/audio streams stalling; 2 customers marked critical (external live captions and game voice). Not huge user base but high business impact for those flows.

leo (sre): quick root hypothesis: rollout introduced zero-weight for failover zone and due to hash_seed being blank on some shards many keys hash to bucket 0 -> disproportionate routing to ap1a-node-21/22 -> cache churn and CPU saturation -> retries and streaming stalls.

hana (router): confirmed on routing logs: several shards show hash_seed="" and zone_fallback weights like {ap1b:0.0, ap1a:1.0}. That combination deterministically maps many hashes to the same bucket. Example snippet: 
```
shard=1337 config: {hash_seed:"", buckets:1024, zone_fallback:{ap1b:0.0,ap1a:1.0}}
```
Simulated replay with that config reproduces tail spike locally.

maya (oncall): mitigation plan — what's fastest to get p99 down?

hana (router): options: 1) Roll back aff-2026-06-01-18 to previous stable policy (fastest and safest) 2) Enable randomized salt override on router to force immediate redistribution (quick but slightly more variance) 3) Toggle global-fallback to allow spill to other regions (reduces load on hot nodes but increases typical latency). My recommendation: rollback + global-fallback toggle as stopgap.

leo (sre): agree. also scale the streaming backend in ap1a and prewarm caches for top hot keys. add temporary retry-throttle to prevent retry amplification.

maya (oncall): execute: hana rollback, leo scale & warm, owen monitor cache/streaming, zara prepare status & customer comms. status-bot prep update.

hana (router): kicking rollback for aff-2026-06-01-18 -> aff-stable-2026-05-28 now.

deploy-bot: rollback job created: job=rb-aff-99821, initiated by hana.

leo (sre): scaling streaming cluster in ap1a: `k scale deploy/streaming-backend-ap1a --replicas=+4` -> started. warming cache for keys: `prefetch --keys=customer:9001,customer:314,stream:alpha-7`. Also applying retry throttle: `router.retry.limit=60/s`.

owen (runtime): enabling global-fallback toggle for pool router-ap1: `./admin toggle-global-fallback --pool=router-ap1 --enable=true` -> done. Monitoring ingress spill rates.

status-bot: Draft status update ready: "We are investigating elevated tail latency impacting streaming in ap-southeast-1. Actions in progress: routing policy rollback and backend scaling; brief rerouting may occur. We will post updates as we have them." Approve to publish?

maya (oncall): publish now.

status-bot: Status page updated.

deploy-bot: rollback for aff-2026-06-01-18 completed: job=rb-aff-99821 status=success.

hana (router): post-rollback routing entropy increasing, distribution smoothing across buckets. route_mismatch and bucket_concentration metrics dropping.

leo (sre): metrics 5m after rollback: p95 ~ 240ms, p99 ~ 670ms. streaming stalls trending down. cache eviction rate halving.

owen (runtime): new pods healthy, cache warmers successful for top keys. fallback spill showing small percentage of traffic diverted to other zones — latency uplift minimal but tail improved.

zara (product): support update: two critical customers still seeing rare stalls (approx 0.5% of requests). asked them to enable client-side short exponential backoff for now; preparing personalized follow-up.

maya (oncall): containment achieved. create incident ticket and schedule postmortem. set severity to Sev2.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0601-4100012345. PagerDuty: acknowledged by maya.

leo (sre): captured quick logs for postmortem: 
```
[18:02:12] router: apply_rollout aff-2026-06-01-18
[18:02:18] router: shard=1337 hash_seed=""
[18:02:19] router: pick_backend key=customer:9001 -> bucket=0 -> ap1a-node-21
[18:02:20] runtime: ap1a-node-21 cpu=95% cache_hit=0.29
[18:02:21] streaming: stall session=live-xyz
```

hana (router): post-incident actions I'll own: add rollout validation rejecting zero fallback weights and blank hash_seed; add an automated distribution-entropy check in the rollout pipeline. PR coming today.

leo (sre): my actions: add alerts for top-bucket share > 20% and eviction-storm > threshold; add a canary test that replays hotkey-heavy traffic against any routing policy changes.

owen (runtime): I'll add a cache-warm step to the router rollout playbook and a metric to detect sudden cache eviction spikes.

zara (product): I'll coordinate customer outreach and craft post-incident notes with CTA for customers affected.

maya (oncall): postmortem scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC. include router, runtime, SRE, product, and support. tagging follow-ups with owners. closing livepager but leaving channel open for postmortem updates. Great work. :thumbsup:

status-bot: Livepager disabled. Final line: incident contained; p99 restored within SLO for majority of traffic.
